list: The official PlayStation 5 trophy list, as published: 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze, 28 of them hidden until earned.
notes: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words. Every guide below is written in the author's own words for this entry, drawn from the sources listed, and never copied from them. Where the community had not pinned down a method by 19 November 2026, the guide says so instead of guessing.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap: All 55 Trophies
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements Guide (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List: How To Get All Trophies & Achievements

trophies.guide: This one pops on its own the moment the other 54 are done — there is no separate task for it. Plan the road in three parts: the story first (60–80 hours), then the 100% checklist (about 100 hours), then the stranger strands, the five side-story finales and the last meditations (10–20 hours). Hunters put the whole journey near 200 hours at 4 out of 10 difficulty: long, not hard. There are no online trophies and no difficulty trophies. One thing can force a second playthrough — the missable meditation in Chapter 1 — so read the Positive Mental Attitude guide before you start playing.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Finish the story, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands and finales.
Earn the other 54 trophies; this one unlocks automatically.

trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing. It pops as you play the story — you cannot miss it, and there is nothing to prepare. Treat it as the moment to start two habits that protect the whole run: keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, and keep cheats off your trophy save, since cheats turn trophies and saving off.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end.
Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Players report it can pop a little late — when you start the first Chapter 2 mission, 'What's in the Bag?', rather than on the final cutscene — so do not worry if it does not appear the instant the chapter ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing in the whole game that can be lost for good: Lucia's balcony meditation, covered under Positive Mental Attitude. Keep your Chapter 1 manual save until that trophy pops.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Finish Chapter 1.
Play the first mission of Chapter 2; the trophy can pop then.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The asterisks are part of the published name — every list prints it that way. Like the other chapter trophies, it can pop as the next chapter opens, after 'Welcome to Vice City'. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: you can switch between Jason and Lucia and call the other in as your partner, so most free-roam trophies become possible from here on. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter as you go.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Finish Chapter 2.
Play into Chapter 3; the trophy can pop at the chapter change.
From here, switch between Jason and Lucia and use your partner for the partner trophies.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. This is the chapter where the robbery trophies start to open: the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hands you the Snap Gun and unlocks jewelry store robberies (see Sneakthief), and a time-limited street race, Race Against Yago, shows up in Yago's strand — it carries an hourglass icon, so race it the moment it appears and save first. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray (see On the Spot).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Finish Chapter 3.
Do the Race Against Yago the moment it appears (time-sensitive).
Use the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs for Sneakthief.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Near the end of the chapter, the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is' unlocks the big bank vault robberies, which feed three trophies at once: Maximum Withdrawal, Hot Together and A Classic Blitz Play. Tail the armored van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open — and bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the bags alone. Keep a manual save from just before the final mission, as well as your chapter saves.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Finish Chapter 4.
Near the end of the chapter, play 'That's Where The Money Is' to unlock bank vaults.
Keep a save from just before the final mission.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is the second Gold trophy and the last story trophy, marking the end of stage one of the Platinum road. Before you play it, make an untouched manual save: with no mission replay, a save from just before the finale is your only way back if you want to revisit anything in the story. Everything outside the story stays open after the credits — the side-story finales and the 100% checklist, which only appears after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — and work you did earlier still counts toward it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Make a manual save just before the final mission.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a Chapter 2 mission, and like every named-mission trophy it pops as you play through the story — nothing special to do, nothing to miss. It is one of the twelve unmissable story trophies that come simply from finishing the campaign.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the story until you complete the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed. Heist missions are good practice for the robbery trophies later: the Chapter 4 vault jobs use the same rhythm — get in, grab the bags with your partner, and escape the heat.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Play the story until you complete the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Another unmissable story trophy: finish the mission and it pops. There is nothing to prepare and no way to miss it, so just enjoy the mission and let the story carry you toward the next chapter trophy.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Play the story until you complete the mission Child's Play.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops by playing the story and cannot be missed. The mission name is the only spoiler here, and the spoiler setting in this guide hides it until you have earned the trophy, so you can follow the roadmap without reading ahead.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Play the story until you complete the mission Headliners.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It pops as you play and cannot be missed. VCIA is Vice City International Airport — the same place Catch Me If You Can sends you to steal a passenger plane — so by the time this mission is done you will know the airport layout, which helps when you come back for the plane.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Play the story until you complete the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops by playing the story and cannot be missed. Keep your chapter saves up to date around here: the late-story missions lead straight into the Chapter 4 vault unlocks and then the finale, and a save from before the final mission is the one you will want later.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Play the story until you complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — work you did earlier still counts. It is the hardest trophy and the longest grind of the Platinum, around 100 hours of the roughly 200 total. You do not need everything in the game, only the checklist's numbers: finish the story and 100 optional tasks; rob all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and 8 bank vaults, plus 34 of 35 smash 'n' grabs and 50 of 91 stick ups; fence $100,000 of narcotics, $100,000 of jewelry, $250,000 of marked bills and $200,000 of vehicles. For collectibles you need 5 of 7 Kenton treasure sets, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, all 33 underwater discoveries, 30 of 34 magazines, books and comics, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 of 125 cocaine flamingos, both unique playlists, 70 of 79 discovered styles, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 50 of 66 standard weapons and 100 of 255 animals studied. For activities: 30 of 40 unique races won, 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals, all 42 shooting range gold medals, all 4 video games played, 5 of 7 pool opponents beaten, mini golf at 2 of 3 locations, 90 of 100 basketball hoops, all 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges and all 15 of Bret's target decks. Work from the checklist in the game menu rather than guessing — it tracks every number for you.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Finish the story first; the checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Work the robbery numbers: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday jobs, 8 vaults.
Work the collectibles: 100 WAiNK scans, 15 card sets, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 flamingos.
Work the activities: 42 shooting range golds, 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts, 70 challenges.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count, and the game tracks them for you. The 100% checklist wants 300 of the 397 stunts in the game, so keep going past 250 — the extra 50 count toward A Long Road anyway. The fastest way to build the total is to chain stunt jumps and bridge flights while you travel between other objectives, rather than grinding them all in one sitting.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Do stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps as you travel.
Reach 250 stunts for this trophy; continue to 300 for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. The nine are the game's side activities — fishing, pool, mini golf, basketball, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races, races and gym training are the kinds to sample — and the game tracks which types you have tried. This is a natural early trophy: sample one of everything as you explore Leonida instead of leaving it all for the endgame.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Try one of each of the nine activity types — fishing, pool, mini golf, basketball, arcade, shooting range, drone race, racing and gym work are the kinds to sample.
Check your progress after each new activity type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Two shooting ranges hold 42 gold medals between them, and the 100% checklist needs all 42 as well, so this trophy and A Long Road share the same grind. Work through the challenges range by range, and learn each weapon's recoil and the target patterns before chasing gold — a silver first run that teaches you the course is faster than repeated blind gold attempts.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Visit both shooting ranges and work through their challenges.
Earn gold on all 42 challenges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. You need at least one win at each location for the trophy, and the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone time trials done, so keep racing after the trophy pops. Learn each course's racing line first — the time trials run the same courses, and a clean line matters more than raw speed.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Find the Top Fun drone races at all 14 locations.
Win at least one race at each location; then finish all 42 time trials for 100%.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street races and the other race types you meet across Leonida. The 100% checklist wants 30 of the 40 unique races won plus 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals, so keep racing past 20. Do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 (it carries an hourglass icon), and save before it.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Win 20 different races across Leonida.
Do the Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 the moment it appears — it is time-sensitive.
Continue to 30 unique race wins for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the game's side activities: take the challenge against Cal and out-fish him. If you lose, you can try again — there is nothing missable here, so treat the first attempt as practice and learn what the challenge scores before your next cast.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Take the fishing challenge against Cal.
Beat his score; retry as needed — it is not missable.

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade machine and play a game through to the end. The 100% checklist asks you to play all four video games, so while you are here, play the other three as well — a few minutes now saves a cleanup trip later.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Find an arcade machine and complete a game.
Play all four video games while you are there — 100% needs them all.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy is one of the stranger characters whose mission strand runs through the game; his strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks (it has its own trophy instead), so finish his jobs in their own time. His finale stays open after the story, so there is no rush — just follow his strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Follow Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Kenton is tied to the treasure sets — the 100% checklist wants 5 of his 7 treasure sets — so hunt treasure as you follow his strand and the two goals feed each other. His finale stays open after the story, so finish it during cleanup.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Follow Kenton's strand to its final mission and complete it.
Collect Kenton's treasure sets on the way — 5 of 7 count toward 100%.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and they stay open after the story. His strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so treat it as its own questline and finish all five jobs to reach the finale.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: After a Chapter 2 mission, pick up Billy's jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all five of his jobs, then his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying stranger mission strands across Leonida. Not every stranger questline counts: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not, because they have their own trophies — so do not assume every strand you finish moves the counter; check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you complete. The time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 belongs to a strand that does count, so race it the moment it appears. Optional missions can become unavailable during certain story sections, but there are more optional tasks than the 100 the checklist needs, so a missed strand will not block the Platinum as long as you finish eight that qualify.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Complete stranger mission strands across Leonida.
After each strand, check the trophy's progress counter — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count.
Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 the moment it appears; it is time-sensitive.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Randy is another stranger character with his own questline and finale. His strand stays open after the story, so finish it during cleanup alongside the other finales.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Follow Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand has its own trophy, so it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — finish it for its own sake during cleanup. Like the other finales, it stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy in the game that can be missed, and the reason the whole Platinum can fail in a single playthrough. One spot is Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning — she heads out to the balcony to meditate, and you follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay, so do it before you leave the chapter and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops. The other spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18, but the trophy needs all 18.
trophies.missable_note: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears when Chapter 1 ends. Do it before leaving the chapter and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. There is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and follow her to the balcony to meditate.
Meditate at the remaining 17 spots across Leonida, bringing your partner so outdoor spots count twice.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through his target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt rewards. The 100% checklist wants all 15 of Bret's target decks finished, so work through the whole questline rather than stopping at one animal.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Play as Jason and take Bret Vogel's hunting jobs.
Hunt the unique animal with a clean head or heart shot.
Finish all 15 target decks — 100% needs them.

trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; the 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so three sets is only the start of the collection. Pick up every card you pass while doing other objectives — a set you finish naturally is one you never have to grind — and use the checklist to see which sets are closest to done.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Collect cards across Leonida as you travel.
Complete 3 full sets for this trophy; continue to 15 sets for 100%.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game app you use to scan things: scanning a vehicle with it counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive and landmarks as you pass them. The 100% checklist wants 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. Start scanning from the beginning of the game — a scan takes a second and the total builds up on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan vehicles and locations as you travel.
Reach 100 WAiNK locations.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so aim past 50 and leave the 10 hardest or most time-consuming ones unfinished. Check the list regularly and pick off the ones that overlap with what you are already doing.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Open Progress, Challenges to see the list.
Complete 50 challenges; continue to 70 for 100%, skipping the 10 hardest.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The easy way is a bank vault job: the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is' near the end of Chapter 4 unlocks vaults, and a vault job gives you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away. Bring your partner — you need them for the vault anyway — then lose the cops and get out of the red heat zone. The trophy pops once you have left the heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so keep driving until the heat is fully gone.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Bring your partner and start a bank vault job (4-star Wanted Level on entry).
Lose the police and escape the red heat zone completely.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner first, then hit the green robbery icons on the map one after another. The chain breaks if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone — the Wanted Level itself must stay up the whole time. Take a few items in each shop; blowing the back-room safe with sticky bombs helps it count. It opens up after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, once you can switch characters. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, call your partner.
Rob three shops in a row, keeping the Wanted Level up the whole time.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop for the trophy to pop.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive — the total builds up fast. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning after this trophy pops. A varied route through Vice City traffic is worth more than circling one block.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as you drive.
Discover 100 vehicles; continue to 200 base models for 100%.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies — the guards at an illegal operation are a good target — and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus, so build it up before you start. Line the group up first, then trigger Focus and drop all five before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Find a group of gang enemies, such as guards at an illegal operation.
Aim, press L3 and R3 to trigger Combat Focus, and take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport. Only a large plane docked at a boarding bridge counts — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Go to Vice City International Airport and save first.
Take a large plane docked at a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4 work).
Back out to the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km from the airport.

trophies.guide: Get into a military Rhino tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy police response, so do not plan anything delicate right after.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Save first, then go to Mile Zero Air Station in the far southwest.
Take a Rhino tank from the south side of the base.
Drive and fire until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Play Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's locked back door — do not kick it in.
Find the safe code note in the back room, open the safe, and leave unseen.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through 'That's Where The Money Is', an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults, so keep going after the fifth.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Play 'That's Where The Money Is' near the end of Chapter 4 to unlock vaults.
Tail an armored van to a large bank and enter the vault with your partner.
Rob and escape 5 vaults (8 for 100%).

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. This is the classic GTA robbery in miniature: find an armored truck, stop it, take the cash and get away clean. It pairs naturally with the vault work in Chapter 4 — tailing the armored van for 'That's Where The Money Is' puts you right next to the trucks, and the escape skills are the same: break line of sight, then get out of the heat zone before the trophy check runs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Find an armored truck and stop it.
Take the cash and escape the police.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map. The simplest way is to drive everywhere: the map reveals as you travel, and the WAiNK app helps you log what you find. Fold this into everything else — every trip to a race, a robbery or a collectible should take a road you have not driven yet, and the map will fill itself in over the course of the story and the 100% cleanup.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Drive every region of Leonida until the map is fully uncovered.
Use the WAiNK app on landmarks as you pass them.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Illegal operations are the gang-run fronts marked around the map; hit one per gang. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so this trophy pops along the way to the full set. Operations are also good hunting grounds for Gunslinger, since their guards come in groups.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Rob an illegal operation for each of the nine gangs.
Continue to all 39 operations for 100%.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description is the whole clue: find a spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail, and enjoy it. The exact trigger was still being confirmed by the community on 19 November 2026 — the guide KeenGamer published for launch day lists it as 'exact trigger still being confirmed' — so if it does not pop at the first bar you try, work along the beachfront and try the other spots with a view before assuming you did it wrong.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a bar or spot with a view.
Order and enjoy a cocktail there.
If it does not pop, try the other beachfront spots — the exact trigger was still unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description is a nod to the series' old showroom-smash moments: get into a vehicle inside a showroom and drive it straight out through the glass. The exact method was still unconfirmed by the community on 19 November 2026 — KeenGamer lists it as 'exact method still unconfirmed' — so treat the first attempt as an experiment: pick a showroom, get in a car, and smash out. If it does not pop, try a different showroom or a different exit before writing the trophy off.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Find a vehicle showroom and get into a car inside it.
Smash your way out through the glass.
If it does not pop, try another showroom — the exact method was still unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable — you can return and finish the job.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling (Kolt & Associates) in Chapter 2 with Sticky Bombs.
Take the luxury watch, the shotgun, and the office safe contents (blow the safe with a Sticky Bomb).
Escape the police. If you missed a valuable, the operation returns later.

trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you — the beach gym is a good spot, and training together builds both characters at once. Keep at it until both hit maximum Strength; the trophy should pop when the second one maxes out.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Buy a gym membership.
Train with your partner at the gym until both Jason and Lucia reach maximum Strength.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed the count, so it fills up without a separate grind — every stick up, smash 'n' grab, gang operation and brawl moves it along. Just play the game: by the time you have done the 39 gang operations, the bank jobs and the 50 stick ups the 100% checklist wants, the 500 will be done too. Check the profile counter in the Progress menu if you want to see how close you are.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Rob, fight and cause trouble across Leonida — robberies and fights feed the count.
Reach 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; it fills up during the 100% grind.

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. The name and description suggest a trophy for something you fail once and then pull off — but the exact unlock was still unconfirmed by the community on 19 November 2026: both of the launch-day guides list it as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed method. Do not chase this one blindly. Play normally, and if it has not popped by the time you finish the 100% checklist, check the latest community findings — a day-old game's hidden trophies get solved fast, and this guide's sources will have the answer by then.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: No confirmed method yet (19 November 2026) — the guides list it as unconfirmed.
Play normally; check the cited sources for the community's solution once it is found.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The description reads like a trophy for stumbling into one of Leonida's odd encounters — the kind of thing that makes you stop and ask what just happened. The exact unlock was still unconfirmed by the community on 19 November 2026, with both launch-day guides listing the method as unconfirmed. The honest advice is the same as for the other unconfirmed hidden trophies: explore, poke at the strange things you find, and check the cited sources once players have pinned the trigger down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: No confirmed method yet (19 November 2026) — the guides list it as unconfirmed.
Explore Leonida's odd encounters; check the cited sources once the trigger is found.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. A drive-by usually means a gun; this one wants a melee weapon, swung from a moving vehicle at someone on foot — the bowling pun in the name is the hint. The precise method was still being confirmed by the community on 19 November 2026, so the safe version is: get a melee weapon, get in a car, drive slowly past a pedestrian and swing. If it does not pop, check the cited sources for the exact setup players have found.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Take a melee weapon and a car.
Drive past a pedestrian and strike them with a melee drive-by.
If it does not pop, check the cited sources — the precise method was still being confirmed at launch.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; launder them by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative, and the 100% checklist needs the same $250,000 fenced, so this trophy and A Long Road finish together. Do the bank jobs and payday loan jobs as they come — 22 bank jobs and 7 payday loan jobs are on the checklist anyway — and fence the bills after each one instead of letting them pile up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Do bank jobs and payday loan jobs to earn marked bills.
Sell the bills to your contacts to launder them.
Reach a cumulative $250,000 laundered.

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it builds up on its own as you buy weapons, clothes, food and everything else the game sells. The garages for Little Boxes cost about $160,000 on their own, so by the time you have bought all eight garages this trophy will be long done. If you are close at the end, a round of weapon and clothing shopping closes the gap.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Spend $100,000 across all shops — it is cumulative.
Garages alone cost about $160,000, so this finishes during the Little Boxes grind.

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count — only the eight you buy. Buy garages early: each one gives you space to register cars for On the Spot, and every registered car needs a free garage space.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, open the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all eight garage properties (about $160,000 total).
Buy them early — each gives space to register cars for On the Spot.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars — there is no reason to waste a slot on something expensive.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Play the Chapter 2 mission Moses to open the Scooter Bros app.
Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register.
Register 10 vehicles (from Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray works too). Buy garages first — each car needs a free space.
